editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood taquería where Primo himself greets every customer, serving bold, generously-portioned tacos that justify the 45-minute drive regulars make.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up $2 Taco Tuesday or Thursday for al pastor, pollo, carnitas, veggie, or fish tacos—order the steak if you're going any other day, and ask about their spicy red salsa.
